CREATE FUNCTION mask_vendor_id(vendor_id STRING)
RETURNS STRING
RETURN CASE
  WHEN is_member('data-engineers') THEN vendor_id
  ELSE 'REDACTED'
END;

ALTER TABLE nyc_taxi.silver.trips
ALTER COLUMN VendorID SET MASK mask_vendor_id;
caption: One function, one column, one table -- this course assumes you have this already.

RETURNS STRING

  WHEN is_account_group_member('pii-readers') THEN ssn
  ELSE 'REDACTED'
